facts.fact: Cabo Verde's education ministry, through its higher-education director-general Odair Varela, announced the creation of a national programme of education for citizenship and digital safety in schools for 2027/2031, with digital literacy and responsible AI use among five priorities.
facts.system: Programa Nacional de Educação para Cidadania e Segurança Digital
